Cost & Financial Aid
Fee Schedule
Follow the link below and open the table for the Graduate School of Arts & Sciences for the most up-to-date schedule of Tuition and Fees posted by Financial Services.
WFU Tuition & Fees
Note: Effective Summer Term. Subject to change in subsequent years.
Tuition costs will remain the same for both in-state and out-of-state students effective July 1.
Cost of Attendance
For a comprehensive list of the cost of attendance, please visit:
Graduate Cost of Attendance
Students not enrolled in classes but using University facilities, or faculty time for such projects as the completion of a thesis/dissertation are required to register and pay a graduate student fee of $150 per semester.
During both the academic year and the summer session, full-time graduate students may take graduate courses on the other campus without additional tuition.
There is a tuition concession plan for eligible University faculty, staff, and spouses.
For further information, consult your Human Resources Office.
Student Health Insurance Premium
On-campus, degree seeking students.
View Plan and Premiums
University Financial Aid
Masters Students. There are a limited number of tuition scholarships, fellowships and assistantships available to qualified students. Applicants are considered for merit based university aid and are not required to complete additional paperwork. Early submission of applications is encouraged.
Doctoral Students. All doctoral students are considered for financial aid in the form of a tuition scholarship and stipend for living expenses.
External Financial Aid
Information on external financial aid may be obtained by contacting the Student Financial Aid Office at 336-758-5154 or by e-mail at . Students applying for financial aid must be in good academic standing.
Students are encouraged to access information from their local communities regarding private organizations and government agencies providing support for graduate study. Examples of some of these agencies are:
U.S. Department of Energy Computational Sciences Fellowship
U.S. Department of Defense National Defense Science and Engineering Graduate Fellowship
The Ford Foundation
National Science Foundation
U.S. Ruth L. Kirschstein Predoctoral Fellowship Awards
Veterans Administration Yellow Ribbon Program. We are pleased to announce that the Graduate School of Wake Forest University has been approved for participation in the Yellow Ribbon Program offered by the Veterans Administration to veterans who qualify under the Post 9/11 GI Bill. Details of eligibility and application procedures are found at the VA website. If you are eligible for this program and have or will apply for Post 9/11 GI Bill benefits, please contact Milton King () to initiate the certification process.
Federal and Private Loans
Persons interested in federal and private loans may obtain information at http://grad.financialaid.wfu.edu/.
Additional details are available in the Graduate School Bulletin.
